name: v0.1.0-alpha.56
body:
Alpha.56 fixes nine defects found during daily use and six onboarding UX issues.

- Keep concurrent broker operations isolated and recover pending changes before new mutations.
- Detect and repair damaged activation links, including empty package generations.
- Report changes that were applied before a later write failure.
- Check existing state in install previews and reject unsupported options clearly.
- Show progress during slow previews and details before system removal.
- Report unknown GC bytes honestly and explain retention settings.
- Make repeated shell setup safe, including the Linux login profile and both macOS installer messages.
- Provide guarded startup guidance that still works after uninstall.
- Include the bounded startup checks from PR #61.

Supports Linux x86-64 with systemd and Apple Silicon macOS. Public flakes remain macOS-only. This alpha uses the existing test trust root. The macOS package is ad-hoc signed and is not notarized.

Release verification is in progress. This draft is not ready for public use.

Alpha.55 remains unpublished. Its native check found the remaining macOS wrapper message. Alpha.56 includes that correction and the related Linux profile correction.
